review_candidates.title: Warehouse Assistant
review_candidates.description: With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith. Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories! Key Responsibilities The Warehouse Assistant will manage day-to-day operations at the Saida warehouse under World Vision Lebanon (WVL) management and accountability, while facilitating the safe and timely storage and dispatch of commodities supporting Nusaned distributions. The consultant will maintain accurate stock records, coordinate authorized requests and warehouse access, document receipts and dispatches, support post-distribution reconciliation, manage returned commodities, and promptly report discrepancies, losses or damages in line with agreed WVL procedures. Warehouse operations and shared-use coordination Maintain the warehouse in an orderly, clean and secure condition; store commodities safely; Maintain clear segregation, labeling and stacking; ensure access is limited to authorized personnel; maintain an access log; Coordinate planned access and movements with WVL and Nusaned focal points. WVL retains overall management and accountability for the premises and stock. Receipt and inventory management Check incoming commodities against delivery notes, purchase/donation records and quantities; Record batch/expiry details where applicable, storage location and condition; maintain updated stock cards/registers and electronic records; Conduct routine physical counts and apply first-expiry-first-out/first-in-first-out principles as appropriate. Commodity request and dispatch procedures Receive requests through the agreed authorized focal points; Check that requests include item descriptions, quantities, intended distribution location/date and approval; Flag incomplete or unapproved requests. Requests should be submitted at least five working days before the planned distribution, unless an alternative timeline is agreed in writing. Prepare and verify commodities against approved pick lists and dispatch documents. Distribution Documentation And Reconciliation Maintain signed release/dispatch notes and proof of handover; Obtain distribution reports from the responsible distribution team after each cycle; Reconcile quantities dispatched, distributed, returned, damaged and remaining; Update stock balances and file all supporting records. Follow up promptly on missing reports or unexplained variances. Returned Commodities Receive and count unused or returned items; Inspect and document their condition; Separate usable, damaged, expired or questionable items; Update inventory records and store returned items appropriately pending WVL instructions. Do not dispose of or redistribute items without authorization. Discrepancies, Losses And Damages Immediately secure affected stock and notify the designated WVL supervisor of any shortage, surplus, loss, damage, suspected misuse or documentation mismatch. Record details, preserve relevant documents and support stock counts/investigations. Do not adjust records or write off stock without written approval. Escalate urgent security or safety concerns immediately. Reporting And Coordination Provide regular stock reports and movement summaries to WVL; Coordinate with Nusaned on upcoming distribution plans, quantities and collection schedules; Participate in stock counts and monitoring visits; Maintain organized filing of receipts, requests, dispatch notes, access logs and reconciliation records. Minimum Requirements Secondary education required; training in warehouse, logistics, inventory management or supply chain is an asset. Basic computer skills (Excel or inventory spreadsheets) required. Relevant warehouse or occupational health and safety training is an advantage. Previous experience in warehouse keeping, stock management, logistics, storekeeping or distribution support. Experience maintaining stock registers, checking delivery notes, preparing dispatches and conducting physical counts. Humanitarian or NGO experience is an asset. Arabic and English required. May require coordination with WVL and Nusaned teams and occasional travel to nearby distribution locations, subject to operational needs. Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, inspect and count stock, and handle or move commodities using safe manual-handling practices. Must follow safety procedures and seek assistance/equipment for heavy loads. As a Christian organisation, World Vision is founded on the biblical principles that women and men, girls and boys are created in the image of God, and of Jesus’ love for all people without discrimination. This means that we recognise and affirm the equal worth, dignity and rights of women, men, girls and boys with and without disability and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status. Applicant Types Accepted Local Applicants Only World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.

review_candidates.title: Treatment Coordinator (Remote, UK Hours)
review_candidates.description: Company description Kingsland Surgical Centre is a new private day surgery and diagnostic centre opening in East London in early 2027, with operating theatres, consulting rooms, imaging and specialist dental services. We are building a treatment coordination team based in Muscat to support our consultants in London. Role description As Treatment Coordinator you are the point of contact for the patient from first enquiry through to the day of treatment, and the person who keeps our consultants' clinics full and running smoothly. This is a remote role with a UK-facing workload, so fluent, confident English and reliable availability during UK business hours are essential (approximately 12:00 to 21:00 Muscat time in winter, 11:00 to 20:00 in summer). Managing the diaries of consultant surgeons and physicians, including clinic sessions, theatre lists and follow-up appointments Booking patients in, confirming appointments, managing cancellations and filling vacant slots Guiding patients through the treatment pathway, explaining what happens at each stage and answering questions by phone, email and WhatsApp Preparing and issuing treatment plans and quotations, and following up on quotations that have not yet converted Working closely with the marketing team on incoming enquiries and campaign leads, making sure every enquiry is contacted quickly and tracked to an outcome Coordinating between consultants, the clinical team and the London reception desk so that pre-operative requirements, investigations and consent are in place before the day of treatment Handling self-pay and insurance-funded patients, including pre-authorisation where required Keeping accurate records in the patient management system and reporting on conversion and clinic utilisation Qualifications Excellent spoken and written English, as you will speak with UK patients and consultants every day Able to work UK business hours from Muscat on a consistent basis Experience in a patient-facing, customer service, sales or coordination role; healthcare, dental or private clinic experience is an advantage Confident on the phone, warm with patients, and comfortable following up until a decision is reached Highly organised, able to manage several consultants' diaries at once without errors Competent with email, calendars, spreadsheets and practice management or CRM systems Based in Muscat with the right to work in Oman, and a reliable home internet connection and quiet working space How to apply Please send your CV and a short covering note to hr@morhiby.com.

review_candidates.title: Travel Operations Assistant
review_candidates.description: Company Description Sumba Advisory Group is a hospitality consulting and advisory company based in Sumba, Indonesia, supporting hotel owners, developers, investors, and operators across all stages of hospitality projects. The team combines international hospitality experience with deep local knowledge to provide practical support in development, pre-opening, operations, guest experience, staffing, sustainability, marketing, and strategic advisory. By understanding both global hospitality standards and local operating realities, the company helps clients create commercially viable and locally integrated operations. Through strong relationships with local communities, suppliers, and hospitality professionals, Sumba Advisory Group enables clients to navigate Sumba effectively and build long-term value for owners, guests, and local stakeholders. The organization is committed to responsible development and sustainable success for hospitality projects on the island. Role Description The Travel Operations Assistant is a full-time remote role focused on supporting day-to-day travel and operational coordination for a DMC. This role includes organizing and monitoring travel itineraries for team members and clients, coordinating bookings with local and international suppliers, and ensuring accurate documentation of travel plans and expenses. The assistant will help streamline operational workflows, maintain databases and tracking systems, and prepare reports related to travel logistics and project operations. Daily responsibilities also involve responding to internal and external inquiries, providing customer service to partners and guests, and communicating updates promptly and clearly. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Operations and Operations Management skills to support travel logistics and project workflows. Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to manage data, track expenses, and prepare accurate reports. Candidates should possess effective Communication and Customer Service skills to interact with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders. Previous experience in travel coordination, hospitality operations, or administrative support is beneficial. High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks remotely are required. Comfort with digital tools, online booking platforms, and basic office software is expected. Fluency in written and spoken English is required; knowledge of Indonesian or local languages is an advantage. A relevant diploma or degree in hospitality, tourism, business, or a related field is preferred.
